title: Variable-injective clauses in a cleaned CNF
statement: Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula over the variables $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$. After cleaning $\psi$ — that is, after discarding every tautological clause and then deduplicating the variables within each surviving clause — every clause becomes variable-injective: in any clause of the cleaned formula, any two literals sharing the same variable are in fact the same literal.
hypotheses_covered: ψ is a CNF formula over Fin n
c ranges over clauses of the cleaned CNF cleanCNF_D3 ψ
l₁, l₂ are literals of c with equal variable
replaced:
In every clause of $\mathrm{cleanCNF\_D3}\,\psi$, any two literals sharing the same
variable are equal.
